# Module Map

Load only the module needed for the request:

| Need | File |
|---|---|
| Discovery and requirements | `core/project-discovery.md`, `core/requirements.md` |
| Architecture and coding | `core/architecture.md`, `core/engineering-standards.md` |
| Design system | `design-engine/README.md`, `design-engine/design-system.md` |
| UI/UX | `modules/ui-ux.md` |
| Admin | `modules/admin.md` |
| User portal | `modules/user.md` |
| CRM | `modules/crm.md` |
| Full stack | `modules/full-stack.md` |
| Data and tenants | `modules/database.md` |
| Security | `modules/security.md` |
| QA and release | `quality/README.md`, `quality/production-readiness.md` |

Paths are relative to the workspace root, not this skill directory.
